newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar dominated by August spread trade.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar dominated by August spread trade.

text.p: Spread trading centred around the front August contract dominated the light volume on London's white sugar futures market on Friday as the nearby spread widened further, traders said.
Price movements were tight across the board, as were trading ranges. One leading trade house was said to be a good buyer of August-based spreads and light broker buying was cited in August/March.
"There seems a little more life in the market this morning...the majority of the volume is made up by spreads," said one trader.
Traders said August/October widened out to $9.00 after trading at $8.50/60 in Thursday's session.
At 1110 GMT August was up 70 cents at $313.00 and October up 30 cents at $304.00. Volume was 400 lots.

Traders said while London seemed to have more upside potential, New York's July contract was pinioned between producer selling at 10.90 cents/lb and buy-backs at 10.60. Fund players are still thought to be long.
"The (London) market does feel steady and like it's going to creep higher," the trader said.
Thursday's public holiday across much of Europe had prompted many players to take long weekends.
